query: SELECT r.code_blue_id, r.user_id, u.full_name AS user_name, r.responded_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.responded_at - e.started_at))::int AS "seconds_after_call!" FROM code_blue_responses r JOIN code_blue_events e ON e.id = r.code_blue_id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.code_blue_id, r.responded_at LIMIT 500
